faq.q: Is my image uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. All filtering happens entirely in your browser using the Canvas API. Your images never leave your device. There is no server that receives or stores your files.
We support JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP for input. You can download the result as PNG, JPG, or WebP.
Yes! The preset filters and slider adjustments are applied together. The Canvas filter property combines all effects in a single pass. Click a preset, then adjust sliders to create your custom look.
No. Filters are applied by the browser's Canvas rendering engine without re-compressing your image. For best quality, download as PNG format.

faq.q: Which preset filter is best for portraits?
faq.a: The Warm filter is flattering for skin tones. For a classic look, try Vintage. For a modern, crisp look, apply the Vibrant preset and reduce saturation slightly with the slider.

faq.q: Can I use this for commercial projects?
faq.a: Absolutely. The output images are yours to use for any purpose — personal or commercial. No watermarks, no attribution required.

faq.q: Why do colors look different after downloading?
faq.a: This can happen due to color space differences between browsers and image viewers. For consistent colors, use PNG format and view in a color-managed application like Photoshop or modern browsers.
